'''Tralkov's Bar''' was located in the city of [[Ugnorgrad/Legends|Ugnorgrad]] on the [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]]. It was the hangout for members of the [[Ugnaught Mechanics Union]]. It had underground tunnels directly linked to the [[Mechanics Union Auxiliary Meeting Hall|Mechanics Union Hall]].<ref name="ActionTidings2" />
